Unlock premium tools for a day, plus DNS fixes
• Watch a short ad to unlock a premium screen for 24 hours — no purchase needed
• Fixed SRV and CAA records failing to save: target, port, weight, flags and tag now work
• Far fewer rate-limit errors — requests are paced and retried automatically
• Going Premium still removes every ad for good

• Tonton iklan singkat untuk membuka satu layar premium selama 24 jam — tanpa membeli
• Perbaikan record SRV dan CAA yang gagal disimpan: target, port, weight, flags, dan tag kini berfungsi
• Error rate limit jauh berkurang — permintaan diatur dan diulang otomatis
• Premium tetap menghapus semua iklan selamanya
